description: This file defines the class CURLStringFile, a subclass of CURLFile, which provides a way to create in-memory file objects for use with cURL when the PHP extension 'curl' is loaded and the PHP version is 7.4 or higher.

classes.name: CURLStringFile
classes.description: A subclass of CURLFile that allows creation of in-memory file objects with string data for cURL operations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance with string data, encoding it as a data URI.

methods.name: __set
methods.description: Sets the property value, encoding data as a base64 data URI if 'data' is assigned.

methods.name: __isset
methods.description: Checks if a property is set.

methods.name: __get
methods.description: Gets the value of a property.
